AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

4.
Monthly Investment Transaction Report - September 2019
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
5.
Quarterly Cash & Investment Report
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
6.
School Resource Officer Program
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council 1) Authorize the Mayor to sign a Memorandum of Understanding with the other Peninsula cities to fund the School Resource Officer program; and 2) Adopt Resolution R19-30 adjusting the FY19/20 Budget to appropriate funds for the PVPUSD School Resource Officers Program
Staff Report
7.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council accept the gifts as presented.
Staff Report
8.
Adjustment of Mayor Rotation Date
Recommendation: It is recommended that City Council approve the interim Mayoral rotation cycle until the City is on a November even-year election cycle.
Staff Report
9.
Consideration of General Fund Assignment Designation and Adoption of Resolution R19-31 Setting the General Fund Emergency Contingency Reserve in Accordance with the September 24, 2019 Adoption of the General Fund Reserve Policy
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council 1) approve the classification and use of one-time revenues and the excess of the General Fund balance over the 50% reserve requirement as part of the Assigned General Fund balance to be used for Non-Recurring Expenditures with Council approval 2) adopt the Resolution R19-31 setting the Emergency Contingency Reserve at $8 million in compliance with the General Fund Reserve Policy.
Staff Report
10.
Planning Commission Actions of October 15, 2019
Recommendation: Receive and file.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
Public Comment
ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING(S)
11.
Introduction of Ordinance No. O19-740 Amending Chapter 18.28 (Outdoor Lighting) of Title 18 (Zoning Regulations) of the City's Municipal Code
Recommendation: This item is continued until November 5, 2019.
12.
Introduction of Ordinance No. O19-739 Amending Section 17.08.378 (Short-Term or Vacation Rental) of Chapter 17.08 (Definitions) of Title 17 (Zoning Procedures) and Title 18 (Zoning Regulations) of the City's Municipal Code Regulating Commercial Events
Recommendation: This item is continued until November 5, 2019.
OLD BUSINESS
13.
Development of the Capital Master Plan (CMP) for Fiscal Year 2019/20 Through Fiscal Year 2029/30
Recommendation: It is recommended that City Council provide input and direction to staff and schedule a workshop to begin the process of prioritization and finalization of the City's 10-year CMP.
Staff Report
14.
Consideration to Continue PM Traffic Control at Palos Verdes Drive West and Via Corta Intersection
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council provide staff with direction on whether to continue or to resume manual traffic control at a later date.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
15.
Los Angeles Consolidated Fire Protection District 2020 Ballot Measure
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council provide staff with direction on whether to opt in or opt out the proposed Los Angeles Consolidated Fire Protection District 2020 Ballot Measure.
Staff Report
16.
Update and Discussion of the Activities of the Pension Ad Hoc Committee and the Police Operational Ad Hoc Committee
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council receive updates from the Council Ad Hoc Committees, discuss the status of their work, and provide any direction Council deems appropriate.
Staff Report
17.
Operational Budget Line Item Review
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council provide staff with direction on whether to conduct a line item review of the departmental operational expenditures included in the Adopted FY19/20 Budget, and if so, in what manner and scope to conduct and schedule such a review.
Staff Report
18.
Discussion and Consideration of Filling Vacancies
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council authorize filling the two current Police Officer positions and authorizing filling the third Police Officer position when vacated.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
i.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR, CITY COUNCILMEMBERS AND AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Mayor and Councilmembers to provide comments, report on community activities and ad hoc committees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 5, 2019, AT 6:30 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.
ii.
This City Council meeting can be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on the City Website at www.pvestates.org.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door and inside adjacent to Council Chambers located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, Palos Verdes Golf Club, and Malaga Cove Library not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2. Dated this 18th day of October 2019.
Karina Bañales on behalf of Lauren Pettit, City Clerk
